[RLOW.4.4.1] **Where a read sits decides which fact it reads.** A pattern
binding is in scope where [LGRA.8.6] places it, and a read of its slot lowers to
a `VarExpr` ([RLOW.6.3.1]). Inside the binding's own pattern's `where`, which is
that pattern's join test ([RLOW.4.2.1]), the read is of the candidate fact.
Everywhere else it is of the fact at the binding's position in the token, and
only positive patterns hold a token position, so a negated pattern's binding is
read only in its own `where`. A slot the rule never reads lowers to nothing.
